questions.question: Describe a Pega PRPC workflow you designed for retail or advisory account opening. How did you structure flows, assignments, SLAs, and exception handling?
Your background includes Java, SQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and XML. Which of these have you used most recently in production, and can you describe a component or integration you built?
Walk us through a SOAP service or connector implementation you delivered in Pega. How did you define the request and response mappings, handle failures, and validate the integration?

This role requires designing and documenting an entire software system. What technical design documents have you produced, and how did you ensure they were useful to developers, testers, and stakeholders?
Describe how you have debugged a difficult Pega issue using Clipboard, Tracer, or Rules Inspector. What was the root cause and how did you confirm the fix?
What is your experience designing automated unit, integration, or end-to-end tests? Please describe the tools used, the scenarios covered, and how test results were incorporated into delivery.
This position requires C# and .NET/.NET Core experience. What hands-on exposure do you have with C# or .NET, and how would you approach becoming productive in an existing .NET codebase?

Describe your experience with source control, build pipelines, and deployment tools such as GitHub, Jenkins, or Spinnaker. What steps were involved in moving a change through test and production environments?
In your QA Tester role, how did you derive test scenarios, manage test data, execute test batches, and communicate defects to the development team?
Give an example of a production or business-process issue you identified proactively. How did you assess the impact, coordinate with others, implement a resolution, and help prevent recurrence?
